### Create Redirect
POST /funnels/lookup/redirect
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/funnels/lookup/redirect
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/funnels/create-redirect | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/funnels/create-redirect.md

The "Create Redirect" API Allows adding a new url redirect to the system. Use this endpoint to create a url redirect with the specified details. Ensure that the required information is provided in the request payload.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: funnels/redirect.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateRedirectParams:
- locationId* string (e.g. "6p2RxpgtMKQwO3E6IUaT")
- domain* string (e.g. "example.com")
- path* string (e.g. "/Hello")
- target* string (e.g. "https://www.google.com")
- action* string (enum: funnel | website | url | all; e.g. "URL")

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- data* object - Data containing details of the created redirect
  - id* string - Unique identifier of the redirect
  - locationId* string - Identifier of the location associated with the redirect
  - domain* string - Domain where the redirect occurs
  - path* string - Original path that will be redirected
  - pathLowercase* string - Lowercase version of the original path
  - type* string - Type of redirect (e.g., Permanent, Temporary)
  - target* string - Target URL to which the original path will be redirected
  - action* string - Action performed by the redirect

Errors: 422 (422: see Common error responses)
